cases.title: Hepatocyte insulin binding and receptor trafficking
cases.publication_year_note: Upstream folder says 2014; the linked publication is from 2015.
adaptations: Use conditions model1_data12 and model1_data13 (experiment-series 2, doses 10 and 100), all extracellular insulin measurements.
Split duplicate observations by occurrence within each time into two bookkeeping records per dose. Do not claim longitudinal replicate identities; no averaging or interpolation.
Fix initial receptor pools from parameter-table nominal ini_R1 and ini_R2fold; Rec2 is their product.
Rename observable_Insulin to Insulin_signal and selected experiment-series-2 nuisance parameters to offset, scale and km.
Use mean squared log10 residuals with equal record weights. Omit upstream priors and fitted noise; keep original bounds for selected parameters.
